summary: Alert System with Enhanced Reasoning & Confirmations - FULLY VERIFIED. Backend sends alerts with 'reasoning', 'confirmations', and 'direction' fields. Frontend PriceAlerts.jsx displays LONG/SHORT badges, 'Why LONG/SHORT' reasoning boxes, and confirmation chips with checkmarks. All 16 backend tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard alerts are IN-MEMORY only - they get cleared on server restart or when user clicks 'Clear All'. Consider persisting to MongoDB for alert history.
Alert engines scan periodically (Free Will: 45s, Dual Engine: 40s) and only alert on high-confidence setups, so new alerts take time to appear after clearing.
